items.title: Danny Barker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Her and Lizzie Miles were rivals here.

ctx.x: Oh yes. I’ve seen those beautiful pictures of her. Nice looking. What did she do, Esther Bigeou?
She was a singer. Sang creole songs. There’s some records out available. Her and Lizzie Miles were rivals here.

items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: And we was living with Lizzie Niles.

ctx.x: No, no. I want everybody together here.

I'll tell you what happened. Before Sylvia was born... Well, we were married five years before we had any kids, you know. And we was living with Lizzie Niles. Now, Lizzie Niles, you know, she was a great singer...
I know that name, Lizzie Niles.
